name: Ruby Final
author: AnnieBergo1
description: WASD to move, C to shoot cogs, X to speak to Jambi. Help Jambi fix the broken robots, watch out for the spikes and pick up health and ammo as you need. There's a blue potion that will grant you a speed boost Swing by the little fox and and sit by the bonfire. Watch out for the red bot, it's more potent than the others!
